name: Agedo
source:
The chief of Matsurika Village and Fey's father. 
He is lively and easy to talk to.

When the protagonist's mother conceived the protagonist despite being unmarried, he did not ask many questions but offered his hand.
Later, after her mother passed away, he has been taking care of the protagonist.
